name: Greenland National Data Centre / Data and Green Power Centre
developer: Government of Barbados / Ministry of Industry, Innovation, Science and Technology / Barbados Investment Development Corporation
notes: CBC reported Barbados' first data centre will be at Greenland, St Andrew and that site clearing had started for electrical infrastructure. Barbados Today reported the project is designed to scale from a 100 kW system to 15 MW, with the first 5 MW government-owned and 10 MW open to private investors; it will support AI compute, cloud services, and green electricity. Barbados Policy Pulse corroborated location, 15 MW scale, and clearing status while raising water/cooling questions.

name: Cloud Carib Barbados CaribPod / cloud data-centre facility
notes: Cloud Carib's official cloud-facilities page lists Barbados among its data-centre locations and describes operated CaribPods in secure, redundant regional data centres. A 2021 company release also states Cloud Carib has data centres in Barbados. Division inferred as Saint Michael from Bridgetown/Saint Michael business-location references found during search; exact facility address was not published in the official source.

name: Digicel Business Barbados colocation data centre
notes: Digicel Business's Barbados colocation page says customers can rent space in a data-centre for servers and computing hardware, with audited reliability, always-on power, security, backup generators, UPS, and cooling. Datacenters.com lists Digicel Business as having one Barbados data center in Bridgetown, Saint Michael.
